worksheet.firstUseDisclosure: Wealthfolio can calculate adjustments from your target, the securities you mark as eligible, and the allocation rule you choose. Every figure stays editable before you review it. It does not recommend investments or place trades.
worksheet.fullDisclosure: Wealthfolio calculates adjustments from your target, the securities you marked as eligible, and the allocation rule you chose, using your recorded holdings, prices, and exchange rates. Every line can be edited or removed. It does not choose investments, determine suitable changes, or execute transactions. Actual results may differ because prices can change and fees, taxes, and execution are not included.
